Association pathways between AI 
training recommendation 
dependence and athletes’ 
psychological characteristics 
related to autonomous judgment
Xiaogan Chen *
Department of Physical Education, Taihu University of Wuxi, Wuxi, China
Introduction: While AI-generated training recommendations may enhance the scien-
tific rigor of competitive sports training, their use may also be associated with athletes’ 
autonomy in interpreting bodily states and making training decisions. Drawing on 
cognitive offloading theory, self-determination theory, and the appropriate reliance 
framework, this study examined a serial association model linking AI training recom-
mendation dependence, body signal outsourcing tendency, reduced sense of self-
regulation, training decision hesitation, and reduced training self-efficacy.
